friendship.en: Our friendship is very important to me.
friendship.cn: 我们的友谊对我很重要。

friendship.en: A good friendship is built on trust and care.
friendship.cn: 美好的友谊建立在信任和关心之上。

trust.en: Good friends always trust each other.
Without trust, a friendship cannot last long.
trust.cn: 没有信任，友谊无法长久。

share.en: I like to share my food with friends.
share.cn: 我喜欢和朋友分享食物。

share.en: Good friends share their joys and worries with each other.
share.cn: 好朋友彼此分享快乐和烦恼。

secret.en: A real friend will never tell your secrets to others.
secret.cn: 真正的朋友绝不会把你的秘密告诉别人。

kind.en: A kind person is always ready to help others.
kind.cn: 善良的人总是乐于帮助别人。

helpful.en: My partner is helpful and friendly.
helpful.cn: 我的搭档乐于助人又友好。

helpful.en: A helpful classmate often helps others with their lessons.
helpful.cn: 乐于助人的同学常帮助别人学习功课。

quarrel.en: We sometimes quarrel over small things.
quarrel.cn: 我们有时会为小事争吵。

quarrel.en: Good friends may quarrel, but they soon forgive each other.
quarrel.cn: 好朋友也会争吵，但很快就会原谅彼此。

forgive.en: It is not easy to forgive a friend.
Learning to forgive makes our friendship stronger.
forgive.cn: 学会原谅会让我们的友谊更牢固。

support.cn: 我的朋友们总是支持我。

support.en: True friends support each other in hard times.
support.cn: 真正的朋友在困难时彼此支持。

promise.en: A friend who keeps every promise can be trusted.
promise.cn: 信守每一个承诺的朋友值得信任。

childhood.en: We have been friends since childhood.
childhood.cn: 我们从童年起就是朋友。

childhood.en: My childhood friend and I still share many happy memories.
childhood.cn: 我和童年的朋友至今仍共享许多快乐的回忆。

partner.en: He is my partner in the game.
A good partner works together with you and never gives up.
partner.cn: 好搭档会与你合作，从不放弃。

neighbour.en: Our neighbour is very kind to us.
neighbour.cn: 我们的邻居对我们很好。

neighbour.en: A friendly neighbour often helps us when we are in need.
neighbour.cn: 友善的邻居常在我们需要时伸出援手。

online.en: I often chat with my friends online.
online.cn: 我常和朋友在网上聊天。

online.en: We should be careful when we make friends online.
online.cn: 我们在网上交朋友时应当小心。

carefully.en: A good friend listens carefully to your problems.
carefully.cn: 好朋友会仔细倾听你的烦恼。

travel.en: We will travel to Beijing this summer.
travel.cn: 今年夏天我们要去北京旅行。

travel.en: Travelling around the world helps us learn new cultures.
travel.cn: 环游世界能帮助我们了解新文化。

abroad.en: Many students hope to study abroad in the future.
abroad.cn: 许多学生希望将来出国留学。

passport.en: You need a passport to travel to a foreign country.

ticket.en: I bought two tickets for the show.
We booked our flight tickets online last week.
ticket.cn: 上周我们在网上订了机票。

suitcase.en: She packed her suitcase for the trip.
suitcase.cn: 她为旅行收拾好了手提箱。

suitcase.en: I put my clothes and souvenirs in the suitcase.
suitcase.cn: 我把衣服和纪念品放进手提箱。

airport.en: We arrived at the airport early.
The airport was full of travellers from many countries.
airport.cn: 机场里挤满了来自许多国家的旅客。

flight.en: The flight to London takes about eleven hours.
flight.cn: 飞往伦敦的航班大约需要十一个小时。

tour.en: We took a tour of the old town.
Our school tour to the museum was really exciting.
tour.cn: 我们学校去博物馆的参观非常令人兴奋。

foreign.en: I want to learn a foreign language.
Travelling lets us meet people from many foreign countries.
foreign.cn: 旅行让我们结识来自许多国家的人。

culture.en: Every country has its own culture.
culture.cn: 每个国家都有自己的文化。

culture.en: Travelling abroad helps us understand different cultures.
culture.cn: 出国旅行帮助我们理解不同的文化。

souvenir.en: I bought a souvenir for my mother.
souvenir.cn: 我给妈妈买了一件纪念品。

souvenir.en: We collected souvenirs from every city we visited.
souvenir.cn: 我们在去过的每个城市都收集了纪念品。

museum.cn: 我们昨天参观了博物馆。

museum.en: The museum shows the long history of this old city.
museum.cn: 博物馆展示了这座古城悠久的历史。

delicious.en: We tasted many delicious foreign dishes on our trip.
delicious.cn: 旅途中我们品尝了许多美味的外国菜肴。

language.cn: 英语是一门有用的语言。

language.en: Learning a foreign language helps us travel more easily.
language.cn: 学习一门外语让我们旅行更方便。

experience.cn: 旅行是一段美好的经历。

experience.en: The trip gave me an experience I will never forget.
experience.cn: 这次旅行给了我一段难忘的经历。

animal.en: We should protect wild animals and their homes.
animal.cn: 我们应当保护野生动物和它们的家园。

wild.en: Many wild animals live in the forest.
wild.cn: 许多野生动物生活在森林里。

wild.en: Wild animals need a safe place to live freely.
wild.cn: 野生动物需要一个能自由生活的安全之地。

protect.cn: 我们必须保护濒危动物。

protect.en: It is everyone's duty to protect wild animals from hunters.
protect.cn: 保护野生动物免受猎人伤害是每个人的责任。

endangered.en: The panda is an endangered species.
Many endangered species may become extinct without our help.
endangered.cn: 没有我们的帮助，许多濒危物种可能会灭绝。

hunter.en: Hunters kill many animals every year.
hunter.cn: 猎人每年杀死许多动物。

hunter.en: We must stop hunters from killing endangered animals.
hunter.cn: 我们必须阻止猎人猎杀濒危动物。

forest.en: Many animals live in the forest.
forest.cn: 许多动物生活在森林里。

forest.en: The forest is the home of countless wild animals.
forest.cn: 森林是无数野生动物的家园。

habitat.en: When we cut down trees, we destroy animals' habitats.
habitat.cn: 当我们砍树时，就破坏了动物的栖息地。

species.en: There are many species of birds here.
Some species of animals are in danger of dying out.
species.cn: 有些动物物种正面临灭绝的危险。

extinct.en: If we do nothing, these animals will soon be extinct.
extinct.cn: 如果我们不采取行动，这些动物很快就会灭绝。

kindness.cn: 动物能感受到我们的善意。

kindness.en: We should treat all animals with love and kindness.
kindness.cn: 我们应当用爱与善意对待所有动物。

care.en: Taking good care of pets teaches us to be responsible.
care.cn: 悉心照料宠物教会我们要有责任心。

zoo.en: We saw many animals at the zoo.
zoo.cn: 我们在动物园看到许多动物。

zoo.en: A good zoo helps protect endangered animals and teaches people.
zoo.cn: 好的动物园能帮助保护濒危动物并教育人们。

clever.cn: 海豚是非常聪明的动物。

clever.en: Some clever animals can even use simple tools.
clever.cn: 有些聪明的动物甚至会使用简单的工具。

loyal.en: Dogs are loyal to their owners.
A loyal pet will always stay by your side.
loyal.cn: 忠诚的宠物会一直陪在你身边。

peaceful.en: The forest is quiet and peaceful.
Wild animals live a peaceful life in the deep forest.
peaceful.cn: 野生动物在密林深处过着平静的生活。

tree.en: There are many trees in the park.
Trees give us oxygen and make the air clean.
tree.cn: 树木为我们提供氧气，让空气清新。

plant.en: If everyone plants a tree, our city will be greener.
plant.cn: 如果人人都种一棵树，我们的城市会更绿。

cut down.en: People cut down too many trees.
We should not cut down trees in the forest.
cut down.cn: 我们不应该砍伐森林里的树木。

oxygen.en: Without trees, there would be less oxygen in the air.
oxygen.cn: 没有树木，空气中的氧气就会减少。

environment.en: Planting trees is a good way to protect our environment.
environment.cn: 植树是保护环境的好办法。

pollution.en: Pollution is bad for our health.
pollution.cn: 污染对我们的健康有害。

pollution.en: Trees can help reduce the pollution in big cities.
pollution.cn: 树木能帮助减少大城市的污染。

desert.en: Few plants grow in the desert.
desert.cn: 沙漠里几乎没有植物生长。

desert.en: When trees are cut down, land may turn into desert.
desert.cn: 树木被砍光后，土地可能会变成沙漠。

shade.en: We sat in the shade of a tree.
On hot days, big trees give us cool shade.
shade.cn: 炎热的日子里，大树为我们提供凉爽的阴凉。

root.en: The roots grow deep into the soil.
Strong roots help the tree stand in the wind.
root.cn: 强壮的根帮助树在风中站稳。

leaf.en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
Leaves take in sunlight and make food for the tree.
leaf.cn: 叶子吸收阳光，为树制造养分。

branch.en: The old tree has many thick branches and green leaves.
branch.cn: 这棵老树有许多粗壮的树枝和绿叶。

paper.en: We should save paper to protect the trees.
paper.cn: 我们应该节约用纸来保护树木。

recycle.en: Recycling paper helps save many trees every year.
recycle.cn: 回收纸张每年能帮助挽救许多树木。

reduce.en: We should reduce the use of paper.
Reducing pollution can make our environment healthier.
reduce.cn: 减少污染能让我们的环境更健康。

action.en: It's time to take action now.
action.cn: 现在是采取行动的时候了。

action.en: We should take action to save the trees and the earth.
action.cn: 我们应当采取行动拯救树木和地球。

water.en: We should save every drop of water in our daily life.
water.cn: 我们应当在日常生活中节约每一滴水。

waste.en: It is wrong to waste food.
We waste a lot of water if we leave the tap running.
waste.cn: 如果让水龙头一直开着，我们会浪费很多水。

save.en: We must save water every day.
save.cn: 我们必须每天节约用水。

save.en: Saving water today means a better life tomorrow.
save.cn: 今天节约用水意味着明天更美好的生活。

river.en: The river flows through the city.
We should keep the river clean and free of rubbish.
river.cn: 我们应当保持河流清洁、没有垃圾。

ocean.en: The ocean is full of fish.
The ocean covers most of the earth's surface.
ocean.cn: 海洋覆盖了地球的大部分表面。

lake.en: We went boating on the lake.
The water in this lake is clear and pure.
lake.cn: 这个湖里的水清澈又纯净。

pure.en: The water in the mountain is pure.
We need pure water that is safe to drink.
pure.cn: 我们需要可以安全饮用的纯净水。

polluted.en: We cannot drink polluted water, for it is bad for us.
polluted.cn: 我们不能喝被污染的水，因为它对我们有害。

drop.en: Every drop of water is precious.
Don't let a single drop of water be wasted.

tap.en: Please don't leave the tap on.
tap.cn: 请别让水龙头一直开着。

tap.en: Turning off the tap while brushing your teeth saves water.
tap.cn: 刷牙时关掉水龙头能节约用水。

shortage.en: Many places have a water shortage.
A water shortage can be a serious problem in dry areas.
shortage.cn: 在干旱地区，缺水可能是个严重的问题。

boil.en: We boil water before drinking it.
boil.cn: 我们喝水前先把水烧开。

boil.en: Boiling water can kill the germs in it.
boil.cn: 烧开水能杀死水里的细菌。

pipe.en: Water flows to our homes through long pipes.
pipe.cn: 水通过长长的水管流到我们家里。

fountain.en: There is a fountain in the square.
The beautiful fountain shoots water high into the air.
fountain.cn: 美丽的喷泉把水高高喷向空中。

necessary.en: It is necessary to save water.
Clean water is necessary for all living things.
necessary.cn: 干净的水对所有生物都是必需的。

electricity.en: Modern life would be hard without electricity.
electricity.cn: 没有电，现代生活会很艰难。

power.en: The machine needs power to run.
power.cn: 这台机器需要动力来运转。

power.en: Wind power is a clean way to make electricity.
power.cn: 风力是一种清洁的发电方式。

switch.en: Remember to turn off the switch to save electricity.
switch.cn: 记得关掉开关以节约用电。

battery.en: This battery can store power for many hours.
battery.cn: 这块电池能储电好几个小时。

charge.en: I need to charge my phone.
Please charge the battery before the long trip.
charge.cn: 长途旅行前请把电池充满电。

solar.en: Solar power is clean and good for the environment.
solar.cn: 太阳能清洁又有益于环境。

wind.en: Wind energy can be turned into electricity.

energy.en: We should save energy at home.
energy.cn: 我们应当在家节约能源。

energy.en: Solar and wind energy are good for the future.
energy.cn: 太阳能和风能对未来有益。

dangerous.en: It is dangerous to touch wires with wet hands.

wire.en: Electricity travels to our homes through these wires.
wire.cn: 电通过这些电线传送到我们家里。

bulb.en: An energy-saving bulb uses less electricity.

fan.en: The fan runs on electricity to keep us cool.
fan.cn: 风扇靠电运转，让我们凉爽。

machine.en: Modern machines make our daily life much easier.
machine.cn: 现代机器让我们的日常生活轻松许多。

invent.en: People invent new machines to make life better.
invent.cn: 人们发明新机器来让生活更美好。

modern.en: We live in a modern city.
modern.cn: 我们住在一座现代化的城市。

modern.en: Modern machines use electricity to save our time.
modern.cn: 现代机器用电来节省我们的时间。

poem.en: I wrote a poem about spring.
poem.cn: 我写了一首关于春天的诗。

poem.en: This beautiful poem expresses the poet's deep feelings.
poem.cn: 这首优美的诗表达了诗人深厚的情感。

poet.en: Li Bai is a great poet.
poet.cn: 李白是一位伟大的诗人。

poet.en: The poet uses simple words to express deep feelings.
poet.cn: 诗人用简单的词语表达深刻的情感。

rhyme.en: The rhyme makes the poem sound beautiful.
rhyme.cn: 押韵让这首诗听起来很优美。

line.en: Read the first line of the poem.
Each line of the poem paints a lovely picture.
line.cn: 这首诗的每一行都描绘出一幅可爱的画面。

verse.en: Each verse of the poem tells a small story.
verse.cn: 这首诗的每一节都讲述一个小故事。

beautiful.en: The poet describes the beautiful world around us.
beautiful.cn: 诗人描绘出我们周围这个美丽的世界。

simple.en: This poem is short and simple.
Simple words can also express deep feelings.
simple.cn: 简单的词语也能表达深刻的情感。

moon.en: Many poets write about the moon in their poems.
moon.cn: 许多诗人在诗中描写月亮。

dream.en: My dream is to be a teacher.
dream.cn: 我的梦想是当一名老师。

dream.en: If you work hard, your dream will come true one day.
dream.cn: 如果你努力，总有一天梦想会实现。

silent.en: The night is quiet and silent.
In the silent night, the poet thinks of his home.
silent.cn: 在寂静的夜里，诗人思念着家乡。

whisper.en: The wind seems to whisper a song through the trees.
whisper.cn: 风仿佛在树间低声吟唱。

express.en: A poem can express our feelings.
express.cn: 诗可以表达我们的情感。

express.en: The poet expresses his love for nature in this poem.
express.cn: 诗人在这首诗中表达了他对自然的热爱。

feeling.en: The poem gives me a warm feeling.
feeling.cn: 这首诗给我温暖的感觉。

feeling.en: Good poems often share the writer's true feelings.
feeling.cn: 好诗常常传达作者真实的情感。

love.en: The poem is full of love.
The poet writes about the love between family members.
love.cn: 诗人写下了家人之间的爱。

memory.en: This poem brings back old memories.
memory.cn: 这首诗勾起了往日的回忆。

memory.en: The poem keeps the sweet memories of his childhood.
memory.cn: 这首诗留住了他童年的美好回忆。

hobby.en: A hobby can grow into a wonderful career one day.
hobby.cn: 爱好有一天可能发展成美好的职业。

career.en: Many people turn their hobby into a career.
career.cn: 许多人把爱好变成了职业。

interest.en: Following your interest can lead to a happy career.
interest.cn: 追随你的兴趣能带来快乐的职业。

skill.cn: 烹饪是一项有用的技能。

skill.en: With practice, you can master many useful skills.
skill.cn: 通过练习，你能掌握许多有用的技能。

practice.en: I practice the piano after school.
Practice makes perfect, so never stop trying.
practice.cn: 熟能生巧，所以永不停止尝试。

success.en: Success comes to those who never give up their dreams.
success.cn: 成功属于那些从不放弃梦想的人。

future.en: I want to be a doctor in the future.
Work hard now and you will have a bright future.
future.cn: 现在努力，你就会有光明的未来。

chef.cn: 这位厨师做的菜很美味。

chef.en: He dreams of becoming a great chef one day.
chef.cn: 他梦想有一天成为一名出色的厨师。

designer.cn: 她是一位著名的设计师。

designer.en: A good designer needs both skill and imagination.
designer.cn: 好的设计师既需要技能又需要想象力。

photographer.cn: 这位摄影师拍了许多照片。

photographer.en: Her hobby for photos made her a great photographer.
photographer.cn: 对照片的爱好让她成为出色的摄影师。

engineer.en: He studies hard to become a computer engineer.
engineer.cn: 他努力学习，想成为一名计算机工程师。

teacher.en: A good teacher helps students follow their dreams.
teacher.cn: 好老师帮助学生追逐梦想。

creative.cn: 她是个有创造力的女孩。

creative.en: Creative people often find new ways to solve problems.
creative.cn: 有创造力的人常能找到解决问题的新方法。

passion.en: He has a passion for music.
With passion for your work, you will never feel tired.
passion.cn: 对工作充满热情，你就永远不会觉得累。
